Updated FII/DII data for any institutional flow changes.
Crude oil price movements, as a sustained drop is positive for India.
Any fresh news or developments regarding the US-Iran peace deal and its impact on global markets.

The lack of clear FII/DII activity and directional conviction could lead to choppy, low-volume trading.
Missing Max Pain and detailed OI data for options makes it harder to gauge potential expiry-related moves.
Unexpected domestic news or policy announcements could quickly alter the current neutral stance.
